title: Fury Scripts
features:
Farming & Resource Automation

    Auto-Farm Plot:
    Automatically hits resources in the player’s plot.

    Auto-Farm Rainbow Island:
    Automatically hits resources on the Rainbow Island in the workspace.

    Auto-Farm World Tree:
    Automatically hits the World Tree resource in global resources.

    Auto-Hive:
    Automatically interacts with hive spots in the land model.

    Auto-Harvest:
    Automatically harvests all plants in the player's plot.

    Auto-Contribute Expansion:
    Automatically contributes to expansion spots within the plot.

Teleport & Fishing

    Teleport to Fishing Spot:
    Teleports the player to the fishing spot coordinates.

    Auto-Fish:
    Automatically fishes without cooldown

Crafting & Mining

    Auto Crafter:
    Automatically fires the craft remote for all crafters in the plot.

    Auto Gold Mine:
    Automatically fires the goldmine remote to mine gold in the land.

    Auto Collect Gold:
    Automatically fires the goldmine remote to collect gold from gold mines.

Shop Automation

    Claim All Timed Rewards:
    Button to claim all timed rewards sequentially.

    Claim Shamrock Chest:
    Button to claim the Shamrock Chest reward.

    Buy Lightning Crate:
    Button to buy a Lightning Crate item.

Shop Auto-Buy System

    Category Buttons:
    Buttons that toggle display of toggles for specific categories:

        Seeds (various seed items)

        Potions

        Machines

        Special Items

    Auto-Buy Toggles:
    Toggles for each item within the category to enable or disable auto-buying.
